issue.title: test_limit_two_with_four_runs_never_overlaps_more_than_two fails once under a loaded check lane, passes isolated
issue.description: Tool-admission overlap flake proposed by phase sase-1vn.4.1.2 (note #1) of epic sase-1vn.4.1; filed by its land agent. See the flake report below.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1vn.4.1.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) of epic sase-1vn.4.1; filed by the sase-1vn.4.1 land agent.

During the sase-1vn.4.1.2 reporting phase (2026-11-27, `sase tool run check` run 7d9af4ce on a tree based on 96e87d5984's parent), this node failed once in the full `just check` test lane under heavy host load (load average ~20). The phase's diff (zombie report CLI/TUI) does not touch tool admission. The node then passed 5/5 isolated reruns and a green whole-module run of tests/tool/test_admission_processes.py. Observed fail rate: 1 of 7 runs, only under the loaded parallel lane; it did not reproduce serially.

The root cause is unknown. It could be a missing semantic wait in the overlap measurement, or a real admission-limit violation (more than two concurrent runs at limit two) that only shows under contention. The second would be a product bug in the property this test guards. Related but not a duplicate: sase-1ve tracks a different node in the same module (test_nested_agent_check_keeps_parent_and_never_queues) that also fails only under load.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (full test lane under host load ~20); serial: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/tool/test_admission_processes.py::test_limit_two_with_four_runs_never_overlaps_more_than_two
